notes: Read all 317 numbered source lines before editing. Imports L1-13 remapped to native: L1 useMemo (react) kept (sortedJobs + activeCount + hasRunning memos); L2 react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') -> inlined useNativeTranslation() NativeTFunction (key,fallback)=>fallback so every t('widget.export*','<English>')/t('widget.noExportJobs','No export jobs') keeps key + default and is threaded into CompactView/JobRow/StandardView verbatim; L3 lucide-react Download -> shared native SemanticIcon name 'download' (no native SVG renderer); L4 @/components/ui Badge -> inlined native Badge (neutral/info/success/warning/danger variant->token-color map; no native Badge port yet); L5 @/components/data-display MetricBar + TimeStamp -> ported native MetricBar (../../../components/data-display/MetricBar) + TimeStamp; L6 @/components/feedback EmptyState -> inlined native EmptyState (icon+message subset; no native EmptyState port yet); L7 @/api/hooks/useExports useExports -> ported native useExports ('/export/jobs'); L8 @/api/hooks/useAdmin useExportJobs -> ported native useExportJobs from useAdmin ('/export/jobs'); L9 ./WidgetShell -> inlined native WidgetShell (same skeleton/error/header/overlay-freshness/pulse subset as AlertFeed/ChargeHistory/DashboardStats); L10 ./shared WidgetBigNumber -> inlined native WidgetBigNumber (AnimatedNumber value + optional unit/label/subtitle/Badge); L11 ./types WidgetProps -> inlined native WidgetSize/WidgetProps (size subset); L12 @/types/export ExportJob as ExportJobExport -> native useExports ExportJob type, aliased ExportJobExport; L13 @/types/admin ExportJob as ExportJobAdmin -> native useAdmin ExportJob type, aliased ExportJobAdmin. The two `import type { ExportJob as … }` aliases are preserved by importing each hook+type pair separately.

Download -> SemanticIcon 'download' color note: the web title icon is `Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-neon-cyan"` (L289), the empty-state icons `Download className="h-5 w-5"` (L198, L302), and the row download link `Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5"` inside an `a.text-cyan-300` (L170). lucide has no native renderer; SemanticIcon tone is fixed per name ('download' -> accent 'DW' glyph), so the text-neon-cyan / text-cyan-300 tints collapse to the icon's intrinsic accent tone — the same color-tint -> semantic-icon collapse precedent set by AlertFeed (neon-cyan->notifications) and ChargeHistory (neon-green->analytics). Title + row icons -> size='sm' (web h-3.5); empty icons -> size='md' (web h-5 w-5). The export/download semantic intent is preserved.

NormalisedJob interface L17-23 ported verbatim (id/format/filePath?/fileSize/createdAt). fromExportHook L25-33 ported verbatim: {id, format, filePath: j.filePath, fileSize: j.fileSize ?? 0, createdAt} from the native ExportJobExport shape (has filePath/fileSize). fromAdminHook L35-43 ported verbatim: {id, format, filePath: undefined, fileSize: j.fileSize ?? 0, createdAt} from the native ExportJobAdmin shape (no filePath; fileSize number|null handled by ?? 0). Both helpers keep the exact field mapping and the `?? 0` byte-size fallback.

JobStatus type L47 ported verbatim ('queued'|'processing'|'ready'|'failed'). normaliseStatusFromExport L49-55 and normaliseStatusFromAdmin L57-63 ported verbatim: lowercase the input, map processing/running->processing, ready/done/completed->ready, failed/error->failed, else queued. STATUS_ORDER L65-70 ported verbatim (processing 0, queued 1, ready 2, failed 3). STATUS_BADGE L72-77 ported verbatim with the variant/labelKey/label triples (queued->neutral widget.exportQueued 'Queued'; processing->info widget.exportRunning 'Running'; ready->success widget.exportDone 'Done'; failed->danger widget.exportFailed 'Failed'); the variant union is typed against the inlined BadgeVariant.

fmtBytes L79-85 ported verbatim ('—' for <=0; B/KB/MB/GB ladder with toFixed(1) and the exact 1024 thresholds). truncateFilename L87-92 ported verbatim ('—' for falsy path; split('/').pop() ?? path; slice(0,maxLen-1)+'…' when over maxLen). The 28-char maxLen call (L139) is preserved in JobRow.

'success' : 'neutral' }. The t param type is the NativeTFunction (key,fallback)=>string (web's `(key, fallback) => string`).

JobRow L121-178 ported: web `div.flex items-center gap-2 min-h-[44px] px-1 py-1.5 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] last:border-b-0` -> RN View styles.row {flexDirection row, alignItems center, gap 8, minHeight 44, paddingHorizontal 4, paddingVertical 6, borderBottomWidth 1 borderBottomColor token border} + styles.rowLast {borderBottomWidth 0}. The web `last:border-b-0` divider quirk (which actually depends on the processing progress-bar sibling) collapses to the standard native `isLast` flag — no border on the final visible row — preserving the row-divider visual intent; border-subtle -> colors.border. Format badge L143-145 (Badge neutral sm) -> native Badge variant='neutral' children=(job.format ?? '').toUpperCase() || '—'. File size L148-150 (shrink-0 text-xs tabular-nums text-secondary w-16 text-right) -> AppText width 64 right-aligned mono textSecondary, fmtBytes(job.fileSize ?? 0). Status badge L153-155 (Badge cfg.variant sm min-w-[52px] justify-center) -> native Badge variant=cfg.variant style=statusBadge {minWidth 52, center}, children=t(cfg.labelKey,cfg.label). Relative time L158-160 (span shrink-0 w-14 text-right > TimeStamp className text-[10px] text-muted) -> View width 56 align flex-end wrapping the ported TimeStamp value={job.createdAt} style={fontSize 10, textMuted, right}; the web className is a no-op on native so the 10px/muted intent is carried via style.

JobRow download affordance L162-175 (showDownload only): the web renders, when job.filePath && status==='ready', an `<a href="/api/v1/export/download/${job.id}" className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-300" title={t('widget.exportDownload','Download')}>` with a Download icon; else a `<span className="shrink-0 w-[44px]" />` spacer. DOM `<a href>` has no native analogue (contract rule 7): it is reproduced as a Pressable (accessibilityRole='button', accessibilityLabel=t('widget.exportDownload','Download'), hitSlop 6, 44x44 min) whose onPress hands the SAME endpoint to the platform URL handler via Linking.openURL(apiUrl(`/export/download/${job.id}`)) — apiUrl resolves to `{base}/api/v1/export/download/${job.id}`, a byte-identical path to the web href — with a swallowed .catch so an unresolvable URL never crashes the row. The non-ready/no-file branch renders the 44px-wide spacer View. showDownload is wired only on isWide (≥3-col) widgets, matching web.

StandardView L182-219 ported: visible = jobs.slice(0, maxItems) (L193). Empty L195-203: when visible.length===0, the inlined native EmptyState renders <SemanticIcon name='download' size='md'/> over t('widget.noExportJobs','No export jobs') (web EmptyState icon+message, no-action transient-empty comment preserved, py-4 lighter padding honoured via styles.empty paddingVertical 16). List L205-217: web `div.flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto` -> RN ScrollView nestedScrollEnabled style flex:1; each item keyed by job.id wraps the JobRow (passing isLast = i===visible.length-1) and, when status==='processing', a progress wrapper (web `div.px-1 pb-1.5`) containing <MetricBar value={50} max={100} color="#22d3ee" label=""/> — the value/max/color/empty-label props are preserved verbatim against the ported native MetricBar (its Animated width interpolation replaces the web framer animation; empty label + fmt(50) readout matches the web sublabel ?? fmtNumber policy).

sortedJobs useMemo L253-272 ported verbatim: Map<string,{job,status}> byId; first loop over (exports ?? []) sets fromExportHook(j)+normaliseStatusFromExport(j.fsmState); second loop over (adminJobs ?? []) sets fromAdminHook(j)+normaliseStatusFromAdmin(j.status) (admin wins for dedup, fresher status); items = Array.from(byId.values()); sort by STATUS_ORDER diff then by createdAt recency (new Date(b...).getTime() - new Date(a...).getTime() with the ?? 0 guards kept verbatim); dep [exports, adminJobs]. isCompact L274 = size.cols <= 1; isWide L275 = size.cols >= 3 preserved. activeCount useMemo L277-280 = sortedJobs.filter(processing||queued).length, dep [sortedJobs]; hasRunning useMemo L281-284 = sortedJobs.some(processing), dep [sortedJobs] — both preserved verbatim.

Render L286-316 ported: WidgetShell title=t('widget.exportStatus','Export Status'), icon=<SemanticIcon name='download' size='sm'/> (web Download h-3.5 text-neon-cyan), loading=isLoading, updatedAt, isFetching, isStale, isError, onRefresh=() => { exportsRefetch(); adminRefetch(); } (both refetched; void-prefixed to discard the returned promises). Body L297-314: isCompact ? (sortedJobs.length>0 ? <CompactView activeCount hasRunning t/> : <EmptyState icon=download-md message=noExportJobs/>) : <StandardView jobs={sortedJobs} showDownload={isWide} maxItems={isCompact ? 5 : 15} t={t}/>. The size.cols<=1 / >=3 breakpoints, the maxItems 5/15 split, and the showDownload=isWide gating are all preserved. The web help/widgetId/dashboardId/actions/noPadding/query/error props are not passed by this widget, so the inlined WidgetShell omits them (structurally identical output; the error branch is structurally dead but retained for parity).

Inlined native WidgetBigNumber reproduces the web ./shared contract: a centred column (web flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-1) with a baseline value row; value!==null -> animated ? the ported native AnimatedNumber (web AnimatedNumber, 0->value ease-out-quad on mount) : a tabular-nums AppText; value===null -> the muted nullDisplay '—'; optional unit (text-lg secondary), label (text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider muted), subtitle (text-xs secondary), and Badge via badgeVariantMap (success->success, warning->warning, error->danger, neutral->neutral). The web valueColor='text-white' className default has no native className analogue and collapses to the AppText textPrimary default (this widget never overrides valueColor — CompactView passes only value/label/badge), documented. animated defaults true so the activeCount big number animates.

Inlined native Badge reproduces the web @/components/ui Badge variant subset used here (neutral/info/success/warning/danger): a rounded-full bordered pill (token surface bg + border) with a semibold caption in the variant text color (neutral->textSecondary, info->sky #38bdf8 ≈ web blue, success->success, warning->warning, danger->danger). The web `size='sm'` padding maps to the fixed 6/2 padding; `inline-flex shrink-0` -> flexShrink 0; the status badge's `min-w-[52px] justify-center` -> styles.statusBadge. Inlined native WidgetShell reproduces the web shell subset this widget exercises (loading -> Skeleton placeholder View accessibilityRole progressbar; error -> ported QueryError in a centred padded View; titled header icon+uppercase 11px muted title+DataFreshness; web WidgetShell L59-80 pulse-on-change effect ported verbatim with a green glow shadow). Inlined native EmptyState reproduces the web icon+message no-action placeholder (centred icon over a muted caption, py-4 padding).

State/prop names (size, exports/adminJobs and their isLoading/isFetching/isStale/isError/dataUpdatedAt/refetch fields, isLoading/isFetching/isStale/isError/updatedAt, sortedJobs, isCompact, isWide, activeCount, hasRunning, NormalisedJob, JobStatus, STATUS_ORDER, STATUS_BADGE), the '/export/jobs' API path (both hooks), the '/api/v1/export/download/{id}' download endpoint (preserved via apiUrl), all i18n keys (widget.exportStatus/exportActiveJobs/exportRunningBadge/exportIdleBadge/exportRunning/exportQueued/exportDone/exportFailed/exportDownload/noExportJobs), the status-normalisation tables, the STATUS_ORDER+recency sort, the dedup-by-id (admin wins) merge, the 28-char filename truncation, the fmtBytes ladder, the size.cols<=1/>=3 breakpoints, the 5/15 maxItems split, and the 50%/#22d3ee processing MetricBar are all preserved. No SI unit-suffixed field is added — this widget reads only id/format/filePath/fileSize/createdAt/fsmState/status strings, no unit conversion involved. No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or web @/ UI imports remain — only react, react-native primitives (Linking/Platform/Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/View), the shared native SemanticIcon/AppText + theme tokens, and the ported parity apiUrl/useExports/useExportJobs/AnimatedNumber/MetricBar/TimeStamp/DataFreshness/QueryError.
